type I = { [k: `${number}`]: string };
const fromNumberNames: I = { 0: "a" };
const ignored: I = { 0: 1 };
interface X { [k: `${number}`]: string; 0: number }
const x: X = { 0: 1, "1": "b" };
const src = { 1: 2 };
const fromVariable: I = src;
function inferValue<T>(value: { [k: `${number}`]: T }): T[] {
  return Object.values(value);
}
const inferred: boolean[] = inferValue({ 0: 1, "1": true });
function read(y: I, s: `${number}`) {
  console.log(y["0"], y[s]);
}
read(fromNumberNames, "0");
console.log(ignored, x, fromVariable, inferred);
